query: I have 8 independent items to validate. Should I use one agent or fan out to many?
expected_behavior: Recommends fan-out — N agents in parallel — because the work is independent (gains parallelism + context isolation + specialization)
Notes that fan-out is pure overhead for sequential / dependent work, which the main session should do directly
notes: Guards against both the 'Meeseek of decoration' (spawning agents for sequential work) and the inverse (running 8 independent jobs serially). Independence is the deciding factor, not item count alone.
